descriptionHtml:
要人拍板 D8 · P2 · Daniela

In Today 跨服务器午夜要不要清空；AI 最坏要等约 38 秒（UAT 说约 30 秒）；空转录行「0 lines」要不要隐藏

同一个问题的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-09/S13, TC-16/S16

思路 / Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S21 「整个重试过程保持在约 30 s 以内」 The full retry sequence stays within about 30 s

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T9 The full retry sequence stays within about 30 s.（TFA-94422 AC 7；UAT 3.5）
  • U15 Generate timing: each run logs how long the AI call itself took, separately from the total; any run over 30 s where the AI service was not the cause is reviewed with Vikram. …（UAT 3.5）

测试设计方法：性能（performance） — 量时间，看是不是在要求的秒数里。

Given convex/ai/providers/retry.ts on main: CALL_BUDGET_MS 30000, ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_MS 20000, MIN_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_MS 8000, RETRY_DELAY_MS 1000, RETRY_PRIMARY_IF_FAILED_WITHIN_MS 10000; unit tests e2e/unit/provider-retry.unit.ts (RT-07, RT-08)

When Review the budget code and the unit test results for slow Haiku, slow retry, and a fallback that starts late

Then Haiku, its retry and the Mistral fallback together finish or fail within about 30 s, and the fallback always gets at least 8 s. Computed worst case on main: a temporary Haiku failure at just under 10 s, the 1 s pause, a second Haiku try capped at the remaining 19 s, then the 8 s Mistral floor: about 38 s. …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Doc review against TFA-94422 AC 7, judged on the computed worst case (about 38 s), not on RT-08 alone: RT-08 checks that each deadline comes from the remaining budget but does not model the slow-first-failure path. Whether about 38 s is 'about 30 s', and whether skipping the retry after a slow temporary failure meets AC 2, is Q22. …

在哪跑：本地 code-review（读代码判）；测试方法 CODEREVIEW · 代码审查；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S21 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-14.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；要拍板的人：Daniela；Allure 状态按分诊从 unknown 改成 failed。

问题分类：要人拍板（Daniela） · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-94422 ready for qa

最坏情况下（Haiku 在 10 秒内临时失败、重试又超时），医生要等约 38 秒才看到 Mistral 的笔记或报错，不是约 30 秒。

In the worst case (Haiku fails temporarily just under 10 s, then its retry times out), the physician waits about 38 s, not about 30 s, before the Mistral note or an error appears.

依据：Allure 13500983, code-review fail-pending-Q22. From retry.ts: 9.99 s + 1 s pause + 19 s retry + 8 s Mistral floor ≈ 38 s. The fallback always gets at least 8 s. TC-14 matrix Q22 is open: is 38 s 'about 30 s' under TFA-94422 AC 7, and does skipping the retry after a slow temporary failure meet AC 2? Not in the dev report or ledger.

UAT item: TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-14/S21

The full retry sequence stays within about 30 s

Tickets: TFA-94422 Haiku primary, Mistral fallback via Bedrock (ready for qa)

本地新 lane code-review：code-review/results.json 里 status fail-pending-Q22 → 待人看（只在开放问题 Q22 上失败，还不算失败 → 待人看）。

Detail:

retry.ts sets CALL_BUDGET_MS=30_000, RETRY_DELAY_MS=1_000, ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_MS=20_000, MIN_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_MS=8_000 and RETRY_PRIMARY_IF_FAILED_WITHIN_MS=10_000. Each attempt's deadline is attemptTimeout(elapsed) = max(8000, min(20000, 30000 − elapsed)). chat() passes that deadline into the Bedrock invoke, which enforces it with AbortSignal.timeout.

The worst path:
1. Haiku attempt 1 gets a 20 s cap but fails with a temporary error at about 9.99 s. That is under 10 s, so the retry is allowed.
2. The 1 s pause brings the clock to about 11 s.
3. Haiku attempt 2 gets max(8, min(20, 19)) = 19 s and times out at about 30 s.
4. Mistral gets max(8, min(20, 30 − 30)) = 8 s (the floor), so the sequence ends at about 38 s.

Other paths stay within about 30 s:
- A first failure at 10 s or more skips the retry, and the fallback gets the rest of the budget: a 20 s timeout leaves Mistral 10 s, ending at 30 s.
- A "model" failure skips the retry the same way.
- After a fallback earlier in the same generate, Mistral is called alone with a 20 s cap.

Because of the max() the fallback never gets less than 8 s, so that part of the Then is met. The computed worst case of about 38 s is above 30 s, and that is exactly the case the oracle hands to Q22. Skipping the Haiku retry after a slow temporary failure (10 s or more) is also handed to Q22 (AC 2). No recorded gaps apply. RT-07/RT-08 are static-lane context only, and as the oracle notes, RT-08 does not model the slow-first-failure path.

等开放问题（pendingOn）：

  • Q22

开放问题（openQuestions）：

  • Q22: Is a computed worst case of about 38 s (9.99 s + 1 s + 19 s + 8 s floor) acceptable as 'about 30 s' under TFA-94422 AC 7?
  • Q22: Does skipping the Haiku retry after a temporary failure that took 10 s or more meet AC 2?
  • Each chat() call has its own 30 s budget; a generate that makes several chat() calls can take longer in total. That is outside this scenario's per-sequence rule.
  • Q22: is a computed worst case of about 38 s (just under 10 s + 1 s + 19 s + 8 s) acceptable as 'about 30 s' under TFA-94422 AC 7?
  • Q22: does skipping the Haiku retry after a temporary failure that took 10 s or more meet AC 2?
  • Wording difference: the question's pass rule asks for 'within about 30 s'. The oracle hands the 38 s case to Q22 instead of failing it, so the verdict is pending, not fail.

代码定不了（notDecidableByCode）：

  • Real wall time with slow providers, including runAction/Node-runtime overhead on top of the abort deadlines, cannot be forced on the local stack (out of bounds per the oracle).
  • Self-review item D (a long Mistral note hitting the 20 s per-attempt cap) is recorded for a human.
  • U15 timing targets: whether runs over 30 s not caused by the AI service are reviewed with Vikram is a process step for people.
  • Real wall time with slow providers, including Node action startup and runAction overhead outside the AbortSignal deadline; this cannot be forced on the local stack.
  • Self-review item D (a long Mistral note can hit the 20 s per-attempt cap) is recorded for a human.
  • U15 review with Vikram of runs over 30 s where the AI service was not the cause.

对医生的影响（physicianImpact）：If Haiku fails just under 10 s and its retry also runs out of time, a physician can wait about 38 s for a note before it arrives or errors, instead of about 30 s. / In the worst case (Haiku fails slowly but just under 10 s, its retry times out, then Mistral runs out its 8 s floor), a physician waiting for a note can watch the spinner for about 38 s instead of about 30 s before getting the note or an error.

审查结论（verdict）：fail

证据：附了 2 个。

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: scripted-spec (manual: doc-review). This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
